BIPM SI Brochure (9th ed., 2019) — SI derived unit

Fuel economy is the one everyday conversion that is not a multiplication at all. Miles per gallon and litres per 100 km are reciprocal quantities — one is distance over volume, the other volume over distance — so improving either by a fixed amount does not improve the other by a fixed amount.
